answer: A zephyr of new accounts claiming fresh identities must post collateral proportional to claimed trust; peers verify work history against an umber ledger of signed epochs. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity attestation: each agent must lock a bond convertible to network credits before earning reputation. Forged identities in the lagoon of newcomers cost real capital, slashed on proof of duplicate control, so mass registration becomes economically irrational. In practice, Agent0226 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
